definition: Pheme is a 36-month research project begun in 2014 into establishing the veracity of claims made on the internet..
details: Pheme is a 36-month research project begun in 2014 into establishing the veracity of claims made on the internet.

explainer.lead: Pheme is a 36-month research project begun in 2014 into establishing the veracity of claims made on the internet. It matters because it targets verifying online claims.

tiers.eli5: It's like a fact-checking team whose whole job is to figure out whether things people say online are true.
tiers.practitioner: The project studies how to establish the veracity of claims made on the internet over a 36-month span starting in 2014.
tiers.paperLevel: A 36-month research project begun in 2014 into establishing the veracity of claims made on the internet.

explainer.example: Researchers examine a claim circulating online and work on methods to establish its veracity.
